title: The default shop term blocks Deactivate and Delete with the default reason
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has made an unused term of its own the default for new customers.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, the shop's default for new customers, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-16 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Hover "Deactivate".
  3. Hover "Delete Credit Term".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu shows exactly these items, in this order: "Edit" (pencil), "Move Customers" (person, greyed out), "Deactivate" (archive, greyed out), "Delete Credit Term" (trash, in red, below a divider, greyed out). Nothing else shows.
  • Step 2: the hover reads "This is your default for new customers" with "Pick another default first." below it.
  • Step 3: the hover reads "This is your default for new customers" with "Pick another default first." below it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R1: “Each row's "⋯" menu shows only the items that apply to that term, in this order. An item that applies but is blocked shows greyed out and does nothing when clicked; hovering it shows the reason.”
  • S2-N4: “The current default never shows "Make Default for New Customers"; its "Deactivate" and, for a term the shop created, "Delete Credit Term" show blocked with the default reason (S2-R1).”
  • Key Decisions: “The current default cannot be deactivated or deleted; the action is shown disabled with the reason.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover a blocked Deactivate or Delete Credit Term on the default | "This is your default for new customers" / "Pick another default first." | Tooltip on hover, item greyed”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
